en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Origin unclear, it reads like a modern song about Aegean Macedonian exile; no author known to me. 'Пеесет' I read as 'петесет' (fifty), and 'Уште ни зборот не докажа' as 'had not yet finished the word' (my reading).

lines.en: We are old, daughter, migrant workers,

lines.cyr: имаме пари ќерко, куќи и коли,
lines.lat: imame pari ḱerko, kuḱi i koli,
lines.en: we have money, daughter, houses and cars,

lines.cyr: гледаме внуци, ама друго нè боли.
lines.lat: gledame vnuci, ama drugo nè boli.
lines.en: we watch our grandchildren, but something else hurts us.

lines.cyr: Болка за Нерет ќерко носам на душа,
lines.lat: Bolka za Neret ḱerko nosam na duša,
lines.en: I carry the pain for Neret in my soul, daughter,

lines.cyr: цел век ја носам ќерко, в туѓа туѓина
lines.lat: cel vek ja nosam ḱerko, v tuǵa tuǵina
lines.en: I have carried it a whole century, daughter, in a foreign land,

lines.cyr: цел живот пусти Грци не ми дадоа,
lines.lat: cel život pusti Grci ne mi dadoa,
lines.en: all my life the cursed Greeks did not give me

lines.cyr: да си го видам Нерет, не ме пуштија.
lines.lat: da si go vidam Neret, ne me puštija.
lines.en: to see my Neret, they did not let me.
She had not even finished speaking,

lines.cyr: - Еднаш да појдев ќерко, село да видев
lines.lat: - Ednaš da pojdev ḱerko, selo da videv
lines.en: - If only I could go once, daughter, to see the village,

lines.cyr: на свои блиски мртви, свеќи да палев.
lines.lat: na svoi bliski mrtvi, sveḱi da palev.
lines.en: to light candles for my dead loved ones.
